configuredEnvironmentReceivers.acceptedForm: A variable name matching `[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*`; its non-empty contents supply the bearer token.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.defaultBehavior: No selector default. The configuration file selects an arbitrary supported variable name; documented examples are not a closed allow-list.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.emptyBehavior: In the selected SPIFFE mode the token selector is not read. In bearer mode, a missing, empty, or malformed selector is rejected; an absent or empty selected variable returns BUSTER_REMOTE_CONFIG_TOKEN_MISSING.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.failure: Configuration loading stops before remote-plan work is admitted when its selected required variable is missing or unusable.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.impact: Changing the selector changes the bearer credential used for the non-SPIFFE remote-plan transport.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.invalidBehavior: An invalid selector returns BUSTER_REMOTE_CONFIG_TOKEN_ENV_INVALID; downstream bearer verification rejects unusable credentials.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.precedence: The canonical JSON file selects the key; the function environment argument supplies its contents and defaults to the current process environment. The selected SPIFFE mode bypasses only bearer-token selection.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.purpose: Selects the environment variable that contains the remote-test bearer token when the selected authentication mode requires it.

configuredEnvironmentReceivers.acceptedForm: A variable name matching `[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*`, different from the selected token variable; its non-empty contents supply the required source-attestation key.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.condition: Always required by the selected remote-test runtime.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.defaultBehavior: No selector default. The configuration file selects an arbitrary supported variable name; documented examples are not a closed allow-list.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.emptyBehavior: A missing, empty, or malformed selector is rejected; an absent or empty selected variable returns BUSTER_SOURCE_ATTESTATION_PUBLIC_KEY_MISSING.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.failure: Configuration loading stops before remote-plan work is admitted when its selected required variable is missing or unusable.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.impact: Changing the selector changes which Nova attestation authority the remote-plan runtime trusts.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.invalidBehavior: An invalid or reused selector returns BUSTER_SOURCE_ATTESTATION_ENV_INVALID; downstream Ed25519 verification rejects unusable public-key bytes.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.precedence: The canonical JSON file selects the key; the function environment argument supplies its contents and defaults to the current process environment. The selected SPIFFE mode bypasses only bearer-token selection.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.purpose: Selects the environment variable that contains the Nova source-attestation trusted public key.

configuredEnvironmentReceivers.acceptedForm: The registered mapping schema requires variable names matching `[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*`. The adapter itself checks mapping shape, not each mapped name; the selected variable must contain non-empty text.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.condition: Only an allowed secrets.read / resolve request that passes cancellation and the applicable current-fence check.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.defaultBehavior: No mapping default. Activation copies and freezes the configured mapping; arbitrary supported names are selectors, not a closed list of example names.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.emptyBehavior: An absent mapping stops activation. An empty object or unmapped identifier returns SECRET_DENIED; an absent or empty selected variable returns SECRET_UNAVAILABLE.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.failure: Activation or the resolve request stops with its mapping, authorization, cancellation, missing-value, or fence error; no value is returned on those paths.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.impact: Changing the mapping changes which process-held secret bytes one granted logical identifier can resolve on the next activation.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.invalidBehavior: Registered configuration-schema validation rejects malformed variable names. Unsupported capability/operation returns SECRET_OPERATION_UNSUPPORTED; cancellation returns ADAPTER_CANCELLED; the current fence is required outside the confidential lane.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.precedence: The copied activation configuration maps request.resource.canonicalId to a variable name. The current process environment supplies its contents at each permitted invocation; later mutation of the original mapping does not change the frozen copy.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.purpose: Maps one allowed logical secret identifier to the process environment-variable name read for a confidential secrets.read / resolve request.
configuredEnvironmentReceivers.required: mapping required at activation; selected contents required for each permitted mapped resolve request

consumerContracts.acceptedForm: NativeWorkerOwnershipLease writes String(process.pid), the decimal PID of the producing supervisor. The C converter uses strtoul with base 10: it can accept a leading plus sign or whitespace, but rejects conversion errors, empty text, trailing characters, zero, values at or above 4,294,967,295, and a minus sign in the first character. The supervisor check additionally rejects values above INT_MAX and requires equality with the live parent PID.
consumerContracts.defaultBehavior: No default.
consumerContracts.emptyBehavior: An absent value returns `WORKER_NATIVE_LAUNCH_PARENT_REQUIRED`; an empty value returns `WORKER_NATIVE_LAUNCH_IDENTITY_INVALID`.
consumerContracts.failure: The launcher writes its exact failure code to stderr and exits 125. Failures can occur before or after cgroup attachment and before or after credential changes, including the second parent check and exec. An error does not prove that attachment or credential changes were undone.
consumerContracts.impact: The binding prevents a detached caller from reusing the root launcher after the trusted supervisor exits.
consumerContracts.invalidBehavior: The identity converter rejects invalid text or its unsigned-range violations with `WORKER_NATIVE_LAUNCH_IDENTITY_INVALID`. A value above INT_MAX, a failed parent-death-signal operation, or a different parent PID returns `WORKER_NATIVE_LAUNCH_PARENT_LOST`. These checks do not prove that an arbitrary supplied PID is an authorized caller.

secrets.consumerAuthority: The PostgreSQL container reads the administrator and role passwords during database initialization. The role-bootstrap and migration jobs read their selected administrator, migrator, runtime and read-only credentials or URLs. Prism Control reads the runtime URL. A worker reads DATABASE_URL for the database-backed nonce store only when SPIFFE workload identity is disabled. Backup and restore-proof commands read their selected database credentials. Studio and ingestion do not read this database Secret.
